newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Corporacion Geo raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Corporacion Geo raised.

text.p: Bear Stearns analysts Sobani Warner and Daniel Altman on Friday raised their rating on Mexican construction company Corporacion Geo SA de CV to buy from attractive.
-- "We are upgrading ... as a stronger capital structure and lower-cost financing significantly enhance Geo's competitive position," they wrote in a report.

-- "With net proceeds of roughly $110 million in hand from its recent debt and equity offerings, we believe the working capital financing woes which weighed heavily on the stock for the first half of 1997 are finally behind us."
